286240
echo "===== 黑匣子重部署 $(date '+%F %T') ====="
echo "" | base64 -d > /root/netmon.sh
echo "" | base64 -d > /root/offline_watch.sh
chmod +x /root/netmon.sh /root/offline_watch.sh
echo "写入校验: netmon=$(wc -c </root/netmon.sh)离线=$(wc -c </root/offline_watch.sh)字节"
# 立即拉起(带防双开)
pgrep -f "[n]etmon.sh" >/dev/null || (nohup bash /root/netmon.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &)
pgrep -f "[o]ffline_watch.sh" >/dev/null || (nohup bash /root/offline_watch.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &)
sleep 3
echo "-- 在岗检查 --"
for n in netmon.sh offline_watch.sh; do pgrep -f "" >/dev/null && echo ":在(pid $(pgrep -f ""|head -1))" || echo ":不在!"; done
echo "-- netmon首批记录 --"; tail -3 /root/netmon.log 2>/dev/null
echo "-- 补进v6看护自启 --"
V6=$(ls -t /root/remote_ctl*.sh 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "v6脚本=$V6"
if ! grep -q "netmon.sh" "$V6" 2>/dev/null; then
  cp "$V6" "$V6.bak_$(date +%m%d%H%M)"
  python3 - <<'PY'
import glob,os
v6=sorted(glob.glob('/root/remote_ctl*.sh'),key=os.path.getmtime)[-1]
s=open(v6,encoding='utf-8').read()
line='pgrep -f "[n]etmon.sh" >/dev/null || (nohup bash /root/netmon.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &)\npgrep -f "[o]ffline_watch.sh" >/dev/null || (nohup bash /root/offline_watch.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &)\n'
# 插在看护循环的大脑拉起行之后
anchor='pgrep -f "main.py" >/dev/null ||'
i=s.find(anchor)
if i<0: i=s.find('done\n',s.find('while'))
s=s[:i]+line+s[i:] if i>=0 else s+line
open(v6,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
print('已插入自启守卫')
PY
  bash -n "$V6" && echo "v6语法OK" || echo "v6语法错误!回滚"
else echo "已有守卫,跳过"; fi
echo "===== 完 ====="
